# MeshNoC

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-29

## Definition
A Network-on-Chip architecture arranged in a 2D mesh topology where processing elements communicate via routed packets. Mesh NoCs are the standard substrate for TCC systems, and communication-aware compilation is essential to exploit their spatial parallelism.
